name: The director picks the camera, the user takes it, the Director button gives it back (signed in)
description: Validates the camera director on Eagle S: a plain case link starts with the director on, playing moves the camera from the establishing overview to the ship, picking a view turns the director off, and the Director button turns it back on. It plays 8 seconds, past the 10:26 to 10:28 close-up of the first cut (4 seconds paused right at its edge), so a slow pause still lands on the ship.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-director-01+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Type 424242 in the verification code field
Wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the Director button (data-testid director-toggle) has data-state "on" and aria-pressed true, and "Overview" is pressed in the view switch (data-testid view-switch)
Click the button labelled "Play replay" (data-testid replay-play), wait 8 seconds, then click "Pause replay"
Assert "Vessel" is now pressed in the view switch and the Director button still has data-state "on"
Click "From above" in the view switch
Assert "From above" is pressed and the Director button has data-state "off" and aria-pressed false
Assert the Director button has data-state "on" again and "Vessel" is pressed in the view switch
